description: The document marks the `include_deleted` query filter of ListVolumes and ListSnapshots required, as it does every proto3 boolean that is not declared optional; the API treats it as a filter that defaults to false. Observed 2026-10-14 in the live Project: `GET /block/v1/zones/fr-par-1/volumes?project_id=…` answered 200 with the volumes and `GET …/snapshots?project_id=…` answered 200 `{"snapshots":[],"total_count":0}`, neither sending the parameter.
